# CRD reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-crd-docs.py from crds/*.yaml. Do not edit by hand. -->

Gryvia defines 52 custom resources in the `gryvia.io` API group (version `v1alpha1`, alpha: fields may change between releases). The last column names the operator that registers a controller for the kind; `none` means no controller in `operators/*/main.go` reconciles the kind: the CRD, gateway routes or dashboard pages may exist, and other components may read it (for example `GryviaGpuSku`), but nothing acts on its spec. Full schemas are in [`crds/`](https://github.com/zyvorai/gryvia/tree/main/crds); `kubectl explain <kind>.spec` works on any cluster with Gryvia installed.
